# refinerycms

**Tag**: web

## 简介

A CMS for Ruby on Rails, supporting Rails 6.1+. It's developer friendly and easy to extend.

## 官网

- 主页: https://www.refinerycms.com
- 源码仓库: http://github.com/refinery/refinerycms
- 文档: http://api.refinerycms.org
- 问题追踪: http://github.com/refinery/refinerycms/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/refinerycms
